GCC and MinGW-w64 runtimes - MSYS2 Windows packages

The x86 CAPSIMG fallback uses GCC's libstdc++ and libgcc, plus MinGW-w64's
winpthreads. These DLLs are unmodified files from official MSYS2 packages.
Package downloads and verified SHA-256 checksums are listed in packages.json.

Projects
GCC: https://gcc.gnu.org/
MinGW-w64: https://www.mingw-w64.org/
MSYS2 build recipes: https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages

Source/build packages
GCC 16.2.0-6 (x86):
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-gcc-16.2.0-6.src.tar.zst

Winpthreads 14.0.0.r495.g63ebe6cdb-2 (x86):
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-winpthreads-14.0.0.r495.g63ebe6cdb-2.src.tar.zst

Licenses
COPYING.GCC and COPYING.RUNTIME: GCC license and runtime library exception.
COPYING.WINPTHREAD: winpthreads notices and license.
